reply_text:
I answered Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message: "Thanks, Ilse, noted. You're on the road tomorrow morning (Oct 15) and reachable on mobile. If anything for you comes up here before then, I'll point people to your mobile."

She didn't ask for anything beyond that, so I didn't change her calendar or status.

My reply promises to point people to her mobile, but I can only do that if someone asks me directly. I won't see her messages for her or answer them on my own.
